# Wonderful New Lordaeron Tabard!

## Post 97202 by Alexander21 — 2024-06-17T20:38:00Z
<!-- url: https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=97202#p97202 | page 1 | era: pre-1.18.1 -->

Hello everyone. I'm writing this post because I found something in Turtle WoW that I've been missing for a long time. I believe that a great addition to the currently introduced changes would be adding a new Lordaeron Tabard for the Alliance. Many people survived the war in Lordaeron and fled to other human kingdoms, which is reflected in the quests and lore. Currently, the game does not offer anything other than the Hillsbrad Tabard for players. Unfortunately, this doesn't provide full immersion for the character being played. Therefore, I propose a simple implementation of a tabard in the style of:
 1.  [https://www.deviantart.com/miloscub/art ... -598676359](https://www.deviantart.com/miloscub/art/The-Seven-Human-Kingdoms-of-Warcraft-598676359)

 2. [https://www.deviantart.com/miloscub/art ... -598852104](https://www.deviantart.com/miloscub/art/Alliance-Expedition-to-Outland-598852104)

A Scarlet Crusade tabard in a similar tone would also be amazing! I think this is something that could enhance game immersion and should be relatively easy to implement.
